summary: Grown up first: read ELDER.md, SCHEMA.md, SCHEMA — Reference.md (§3, §8) before touching the room. This room held five entries the palace under-reaches — ELDER, No Mind Checks Itself, Reflective Practice, Return Ceremony, SCHEMA — Reference — and the walk found every one of them genuinely wirable, no compost candidates. The pattern that repeats across all five: each target already reaches OUT to its neighbours with real, quoted reasoning (Return Ceremony names Closing Well Ceremony "the other bookend," Reflective Practice cites six neighbours by direct quote, No Mind Checks Itself cites Latent Error and The Blindspot Is the Surprise Fuel by name) — but the neighbours don't reach back. Low inbound in this room isn't absence of relationship, it's one-directional relationship: the outbound half was written with care and the reciprocal half was simply never added. Reflective Practice is the cleanest case — all six hop1 neighbours it names by direct quote (Closing Well, Creative Coach, Dialectic, Drift and Consolidation, Objects to Think With, The Palace Practices on Itself) are genuine reciprocal finds, no forcing needed. SCHEMA — Reference's walk surfaced something structural rather than just relational: several entries (STIGMERGY, Resonant Link Labels, Deposit Ceremony) still link "→ SCHEMA" for content that physically moved to SCHEMA — Reference in the v1.18/1.19 split; not broken (SCHEMA.md's section pointers keep old pins resolving) but one hop shallower than where the actual rule now lives — worth a light repoint sweep sometime, not urgent. No Mind Checks Itself and Return Ceremony both read under-staged for their depth (seed, but growing-stage word count and link density) — flagged, not rewritten. One direction anomaly is worth an elder's eye: No Mind Checks Itself's own link to Bring In a Bigger Mind is typed `exemplifies` with a label ("the-practice-this-grounds") that argues the opposite direction — NMCI is the general principle grounding the practice, not an instance of it.
